This wasn’t about ticking off eco-credentials. It was about feeling how sustainability lives in the everyday.
In this behind-the-scenes look at our shoot in Germany, we go beyond the cinematic surface to reflect on what really stood out: a way of living that quietly gets it right.
Credits
Featuring the BD x Germany Tourism team:
Beyond the Beauty is where we share how we make the work – the choices, the creative process, and the unexpected moments that shape what you see on screen.
